description: This file implements functions related to process partition identification in Android, including retrieving executable paths, command lines, and determining the partition (system, vendor, odm, or unknown) based on process information.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator to print the string representation of a Partition enum value.

methods.name: getExe
methods.description: Retrieves the real path of the executable for a given process ID by reading the symbolic link /proc/<pid>/exe.

methods.name: getCmdline
methods.description: Reads the command line of a process from /proc/<pid>/cmdline.

methods.name: parsePartition
methods.description: Converts a string to a corresponding Partition enum value.

methods.name: getPartitionFromRealpath
methods.description: Determines the partition type based on the real path of an executable or process.

methods.name: getPartitionFromCmdline
methods.description: Determines the partition type based on the process's command line.

methods.name: getPartitionFromExe
methods.description: Determines the partition type based on the executable path of a process.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Main function to determine the partition of a process by trying executable path first, then command line.
